dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I knew it! Your strategy was outstanding in the Nilotpala Cup and Fungus Mechanicus, and it's extraordinary here, too! I suppose I should bring my A-game!

choices.text: Play another round of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: No problem! You may find yourself pleasantly surprised if you try mixing and matching different Lil' Fungi.

choices.text: Your A-game?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, Boss Golden Comet, Silver Companion! What do you think of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Stop being so formal! We're friends, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We're friends! Saying that makes it feel like we're superior and subordinate, and that creates... that, y'know... sense of distance!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: My concern is that publicly, I'm an employee of the Beast Tamers Tournament's organizer, and the two of you are our highest-level decision-makers.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: According to "500 Things You Need to Know When Organizing a Big Event", attention should always be paid to etiquette and rules, so, using the correct method of address is important as well.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I may need to take up some of your time later to meet with our sponsors and discuss the event.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Like our sponsor this time, the Fonta project team.

choices.text: I guess I can be the boss for a while...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we know nothing about business talk. They may see through our lack of experience if we're present...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "These two so-called bosses are complete amateurs! The deals we offer don't have to be that good!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And we won't be able to refute it, so it'll make everything absolutely embarrassing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that way, we'd actually be creating trouble for you, Haniyyah!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: That makes sense... Hmm, I never considered this possibility.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I see. When it comes to dealing with people, it seems I'm still lacking in experience when compared to you.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I should use this term of address carefully from now on then... No, I should give more consideration to how I deal with non-mercenaries!

choices.text: Not only that, the boss takes all the blame...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The blame? Do you mean... If they think our event didn't perform well, they might blame everything on the highest-level decision makers?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Or maybe, our title of "boss" and our reputation will put the spotlight, and thus any blame that must be laid, on us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if we get a chance to explain ourselves, it'll definitely take a lot of time.

choices.text: We're more concerned about how you're doing, really...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Haniyyah, we haven't seen each other in a long time, and you've... changed so much! You must have gone through a lot!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Me? I think I've been living quite peacefully, in truth.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Souka taught me a lot about vocabulary and grammar after I returned from Port Ormos, and that helped me get through numerous books.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I think my level of knowledge should barely meet the standards of... the lowest level of students?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In return, I helped Souka with physical training, and taught her more rainforest survival and combat skills.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Maybe it was her keen interest in mercenaries that kept her spirits high at all times, but I took her to meet some of my old mercenary friends, and it didn't take long for her to hit it off with them.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: What really surprised me was how we encountered some monsters on the way back...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: ...Only for Souka to leap forward and took them down with a few swings of her axe! She's got a real gift!

choices.text: Guess we look forward to you entering the Akademiya soon, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Right! Paimon's sure you'll make it, what with all the books you've been reading!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Not at all! I don't need a degree. I'm satisfied with taking care of my Fungi buddies...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Anyway, we appreciate your concern. We've been living life to the fullest lately!

choices.text: We can look forward to Souka's masterpiece soon, methinks!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, but she seemed so weak before! Paimon can't imagine how she's gotten this good at fighting!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As a writer who has personally experienced the Beast Tamers Tournament, rainforest survival, and adventure as a mercenary... A story written by Souka would certainly be special!

choices.text: Let's talk about our Fungi buddies, shall we?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Relax, Golden Comet!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Souka and I stocked up on a bunch of supplies in Port Ormos, expanded the camp, and obtained jellies with improved flavors.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bongo-Head and the others are well-fed, and even if they don't go outside their camp, they have climbing walls, swings, and seesaws to keep them from feeling bored.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: And when they go outside, the fungi get along well with the Shroomboars, Dusk Birds, and Sumpter Beasts. Sometimes, they even go for walks on the Sumpter Beasts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, Paimon almost feels like joining them now!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: However, Ms. Najah, who is responsible for improving the Wisdom Orb, has encountered a problem and seems intent on taking the technology in a different direction.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The development of a new Orb is experiencing a huge lack of funding too, so it will be impossible to complete it at the expected rate.

choices.text: Some delays are understandable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Yeah, we really can't be careless with it, so it can't be helped if it's slow going... If only Paimon knew how to conduct research! Then she'd at least be able to help!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Besides searching for reliable sponsors and promoting the event in advance, I came to Fontaine with the goal of finding technicians skilled in this field.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Fortunately, the Fontaine Research Institute's Fonta research team didn't just provide a huge amount of funding to us, but they also promised to help us look for the necessary talent.

choices.text: And what's the catch?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's still kinda worried. Did those guys who invented Fonta really not ask anything of you?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Of course they did. They asked for naming rights and to be the sole supplier.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As such, the next Beast Tamers Tournament might not be the Nilotpala Cup but the Fonta Cup instead. The exact name is still under discussion.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: All beverages sold by the organizer during the event must be swapped to Fonta or Fonta derivatives as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... That doesn't sound too bad?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It sounds like they're just trying to promote Fonta through the Beast Tamers Tournament...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute! If we're talking fame, then we're the ones who stand to gain from this! So it seems like we're the biggest winner, no matter how you look at it!

choices.text: There aren't any competing products right now, either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Indeed! We've won the Fungi important funding without losing anything! It would be a waste to let this opportunity slip by!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I've carefully verified everything with Souka and Mr. Balfour too. There are no traps in the previous contract. Which is good, since I hope to do this well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, after hearing that detailed explanation from you, Haniyyah, Paimon thinks the future is looking really good!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe your trip to Fontaine will be the stepping stone to many great things.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Thanks for the kind words, Silver Companion!

choices.text: Let's make the new sponsors engage in bidding in the future!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bidding? Do you mean making any new sponsors engage in bidding against the Fonta project team for the naming rights?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We can do that? {NICKNAME}, how are you always so full of great ideas?

choices.text: There's no such thing as free fried eggs in this world...
It's an very important device, after all.
See you later!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Sure, seems you two are busy.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Don't worry, I'll be staying here for some time, so feel free to come back if you want to catch up or play another round of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta!

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Also, please consider giving me more coaching if you have the time! I intend to become... a master tactician!

choices.text: Then let me teach you again!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Aye, aye! Don't go easy on me!

choices.text: Since when did I become your leader!?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Oh! Sorry! I've already started imagining what it would be like with you in the Special Patrol... Although I'm afraid we still can't offer you millions of Mora per month.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: But if you ever meet Captain Chevreuse, well, she might just write you a recommendation for a salary like that!

choices.text: Chevreuse?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: She's the Captain of our Special Patrol. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say she's one of the greatest musket sharpshooters in Fontaine, period!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: We members of the Patrol are generally skilled at using muskets, but she uses them like they're an extension of her hand!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: They say she can shoot out a candle's flame without damaging the candle itself from over a hundred paces away with even the most ordinary, mass-produced musket.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: The current leaders of every squad in the Patrol are either sharpshooters who have been personally taught by her or have undergone strict evaluation.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: As a newbie who's just joined, I can barely make a shot from around a hundred and fifty paces away... And it has to be against a head-sized target.

choices.text: Whoa! What kind of marksmanship is that!?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Ugh... I knew you'd say something like that...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Well, I haven't practiced enough, but I'll work harder! I aim to get 2,000 rounds of practice in this month!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Anyway, if we get the chance, I'll teach you a little about muskets.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Anyway, please consider joining the Special Patrol or at least become a Special Member, would you?

choices.text: Whoa? You're that accurate?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Nah, I'm just alright! With your skill, it wouldn't even take that long for you to surpass me!

choices.text: Captain?
Let's talk about you first...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Me? I'm just a newbie in the Special Patrol, so I haven't accomplished anything praiseworthy...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: It's why I was sent to manage Ms. Haniyyah's Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Of course, this doesn't mean that the Patrol considers it a trivial task.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I only took over the job and started gathering information from up close after verifying that Ms. Haniyyah's Fungi companions weren't dangerous.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: In the event that we did encounter dangerous monsters, and if the situation warranted it, then we would have dispatched numerous sharpshooters in conjunction with the Gardemeks...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: The Gardemeks would lead the monsters into a killbox, and the sharpshooters waiting in ambush there would loose a hail of bullets upon them...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: In this way, we'd able to keep the monsters pinned while preventing any undue effects on the service life of the Gardemeks.

choices.text: That sounds amazing!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Not at all! It's just one of our most basic tactics!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: If you're interested in the Special Patrol's tactics, I'll bring a handbook along and introduce them to you next time!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Anyway, please consider joining the Special Patrol or at least become a Special Member, would you?

choices.text: Can that be used on me?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: That's not funny. You're not an imaginary enemy... Or I should say that unless the captain led the team herself, no ordinary tactics would be capable of suppressing you...

choices.text: Then you can start with some self-reflection...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: A—Alright! Ugh... I'm still too weak...

dialogues.text: Whoa! Our gold and silver bosses! I didn't expect to run into you here!

choices.text: Who are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's an Eremite doing here?
Hehe! You can't recognize me? Great, that means my disguise is a huge success!
Alright! Hand over your friendship fees!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We will never give you any Mora!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute... Friendship fees?
A warm hug works too, or maybe a pat on the shoulder? Even a fist bump would be nice!
Reunions should be celebrated with happiness and cheer!
Aren't you happy? The Guest of Tenshukaku, the Slayer of Three Thousand Bandits in Seven Days, and the Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This string of strange names, and the way you greeted us... with "Boss"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon remembers now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Are you... Souka?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Bingo! You've got it right! Souka, Mercenary Mode, is making her debut!

choices.text: Long time no see! You seem to be in high spirits!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you acting just like Haniyyah? You're like a completely different person as well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you wearing Haniyyah's clothes?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Looks good on me, right? It's light, flexible, and breathable, making it perfect for life in the rainforest. And it's just right for Fontaine too. I stay quite cool once I tie my hair up!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: It's perfect for running errands in Fontaine, and I don't even need Mist Flower Corollas for heat relief!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Speaking of which, have you seen Haniyyah? We're releasing the improved version of Fungus Mechanicus, known as "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta," here in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: It comes with brand-new opponents! The pieces were carefully selected and designed based on adventurer stories from everywhere!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Every Lil' Fungi's moves has been redesigned as well, so playing it is guaranteed to be a fresh experience!

choices.text: An even more wonderful experience, you say!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, it's more exciting to go up against moving opponents! Commanding our Fungi friends to victory should feel more awesome than ever!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Recognition from both my bosses, hurrah! Guess I've gotta work harder from now on, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've heard from Haniyyah that you stand in front of The Steambird's office because you're putting advertisements in their paper. Is that the case?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: That's right! I have an appointment with a journalist to write the text for it. Don't worry, writing's my specialty!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Balfour was invited by the Fontaine Research Institute to look for technical support personnel to improve the Wisdom Orb, so we're each doing our own things for now.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: I want to play a round with you when I'm done, so please, wait for me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can do it, Souka!

choices.text: Well done, Souka!
I don't remember!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm, we last met Souka in Sumeru, so it's understandable that you can't remember, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A very long time ago, she participated in the Beast Tamers Tournament to gather material, and we defeated her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But she wasn't angered by that, and she even promised to write us into her novel as decent opponents.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Later on, she started taking care of our Fungi buddies with Haniyyah, and she has been providing ideas to help create games.

choices.text: Whoa! The Eremites are invading!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek! Someone get the Gardes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, will that really be necessary?
Hey! Stop that! Hahaha! You're not afraid at all!
You're a tough duo. Some mercenaries who managed to escape from you painted your portraits and warned others to avoid messing with you at all costs.
Forget heroes like you, and let's not even consider the Gardemeks patrolling the streets. A Blubberbeast would knock me out with a mere swing of its tail!
Not to mention that I'm no invader. I'm just a tourist dressed as a mercenary who is conducting standard business activities.
Haniyyah got Ms. Turenna to send a photograph of me to the Maison Gardiennage, so the Gardes aren't going to arrest me!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait... Did you just mention... Haniyyah?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Are you... Souka?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Bingo! You've got it right! Souka, Mercenary Mode, is making her debut!

choices.text: Long time no see! You seem to be in high spirits!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you acting just like Haniyyah? You're like a completely different person as well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you wearing Haniyyah's clothes?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Looks good on me, right? It's light, flexible, and breathable, making it perfect for life in the rainforest. And it's just right for Fontaine too. I stay quite cool once I tie my hair up!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: It's perfect for running errands in Fontaine, and I don't even need Mist Flower Corollas for heat relief!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Speaking of which, have you seen Haniyyah? We're releasing the improved version of Fungus Mechanicus, known as "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta," here in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: It comes with brand-new opponents! The pieces were carefully selected and designed based on adventurer stories from everywhere!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Every Lil' Fungi's moves has been redesigned as well, so playing it is guaranteed to be a fresh experience!

choices.text: An even more wonderful experience, you say!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, it's more exciting to go up against moving opponents! Commanding our Fungi friends to victory should feel more awesome than ever!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Recognition from both my bosses, hurrah! Guess I've gotta work harder from now on, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've heard from Haniyyah that you stand in front of The Steambird's office because you're putting advertisements in their paper. Is that the case?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: That's right! I have an appointment with a journalist to write the text for it. Don't worry, writing's my specialty!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Balfour was invited by the Fontaine Research Institute to look for technical support personnel to improve the Wisdom Orb, so we're each doing our own things for now.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: I want to play a round with you when I'm done, so please, wait for me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can do it, Souka!

choices.text: Well done, Souka!
I don't remember!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm, we last met Souka in Sumeru, so it's understandable that you can't remember, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A very long time ago, she participated in the Beast Tamers Tournament to gather material, and we defeated her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But she wasn't angered by that, and she even promised to write us into her novel as decent opponents.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Later on, she started taking care of our Fungi buddies with Haniyyah, and she has been providing ideas to help create games.

choices.text: Paimon, run!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! A weird Eremite! Run!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bongo-Head! Kindlejoy! Long time no see! Paimon's missed you!

choices.text: Pinch our fungi friends!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants to hold Bongo-Head and pinch Kindlejoy, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Hold on a second...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You both still look more or less the same, but it feels like... you've gotten rounder!

choices.text: That means they've been eating well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if they keep eating well, maybe they'll be bigger than even us one day!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, when we travel together, Bongo-Head can put us on its head and fly in the sky!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if Bongo-Head gets tired, then Kindlejoy will take us, or we can find a Sumpter Beast and all ride on it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like you're all looking forward to the journey, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Once the Wisdom Orb is improved, and the Fungi can move more freely...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Where should we go? {NICKNAME}, should we start planning?

choices.text: That means Haniyyah is taking good care of them!
Let's feed them first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! We have a few new jelly flavors this time, too. What flavor will we go with?

choices.text: Use the Fish and Chips-flavored jellies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't think the fungi would like Fish and Chips!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess they're not picky about what they eat. That's good! A good appetite is important for staying healthy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Y'know, since we've discovered new dishes in Fontaine, we can tell Haniyyah and get her to develop new jelly flavors!

choices.text: Use the Coffee-flavored jellies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They look even more energetic now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, do Coffee-flavored jellies actually contain coffee?

choices.text: Use the Fonta-flavored jellies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, it looks like they're about to float away!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So they can't have carbonated things?

choices.text: And this is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like a Gardemek that Turenna brought with her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Was it playing with the Fungi while we were gone?

response.speaker: Observe the Gardemek
response.text: (The Gardemek seems to nod as its parts whirl and make low mechanical noises.)

response.speaker: Observe the Gardemek
response.text: (Despite not speaking, it gives off a sense of... elegance, for some reason.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How polite! Paimon will give you a great nickname!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about... Miss Gardemetiquette!

response.speaker: Observe the "Miss Gardemetiquette"
response.text: (The Gardemek's visible parts glow faintly with joy.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Seems like it likes the name!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The fungi will be happy to have a new friend like you, Miss Gardemetiquette!

choices.text: Let's leave for now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we'll come play with our Fungi friends when we have time, right?

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Hmm, will these soft, bouncy, smooth, squishy Fungi like Tidalga?

choices.text: Forget about that for now! Let's have another game!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Fine, bring it on!

choices.text: Keep your Tidalga and dream on!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: The Fungi haven't even tried it yet! How can you be so sure they won't like it?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: If you're not too busy, come back and play anytime.

choices.text: Play another round.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: That's right! I always get more design ideas from watching you, so please, play to your heart's content!

choices.text: See you later!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: We'll be in Fontaine for a while, so I look forward to seeing you again when you're done with whatever you're doing.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: It's alright if you can't make time, though. No matter where you go, we will do our best to catch up to you. I'm sure we'll see each other again!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: The Guest of Tenshukaku, the Slayer of Three Thousand Bandits in Seven Days, the Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor, the Great Bosses of Gold and Silver...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: I had a great time talking and playing games with you. Hehe, I always get lots of inspiration whenever we hang out!

choices.text: Two more games, then!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: It shall be my honor!

choices.text: Looks like you're gathering your thoughts. I'll leave you to it, then.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: No need to be shy. If you wanna have a chat or play a game or two, come and find me whenever you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Special Fonta Vending Machine
dialogues.text: (It seems that you cannot purchase Fonta at this machine. It is presently no different from an advertisement board...)
